name: diamond_share.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (d Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Base (mk-Base (baseVal Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Left (mk-Left (baseVal Int)(leftVal Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Right (mk-Right (baseVal Int)(rightVal Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Diamond (mk-Diamond (baseVal Int)(leftVal Int)(rightVal Int)(diamondVal Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-Base (sel-Base Base))
  (lift-Left (sel-Left Left))
  (lift-Right (sel-Right Right))
  (lift-Diamond (sel-Diamond Diamond))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Base ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Base (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Base ((this Ref)) Base
  (sel-Base (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Left ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Left (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Left ((this Ref)) Left
  (sel-Left (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Right ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Right (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Right ((this Ref)) Right
  (sel-Right (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Diamond ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Diamond (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Diamond ((this Ref)) Diamond
  (sel-Diamond (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Base ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-Base this)
    (deref-is-Left this)
    (deref-is-Right this)
    (deref-is-Diamond this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Left ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-Left this)
    (deref-is-Diamond this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Right ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-Right this)
    (deref-is-Diamond this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Diamond ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Diamond this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.d: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!d ((this Ref)) Ref
  (d (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ------------------------------
;   Getters for class Diamond:
; ------------------------------

; --- getters for Diamond.baseVal: ---

(define-fun Diamond.baseVal ((this Ref)) Int
  (baseVal (deref-Diamond this))
)

; --- getters for Diamond.leftVal: ---

(define-fun Diamond.leftVal ((this Ref)) Int
  (leftVal (deref-Diamond this))
)

; --- getters for Diamond.rightVal: ---

(define-fun Diamond.rightVal ((this Ref)) Int
  (rightVal (deref-Diamond this))
)

; --- getters for Diamond.diamondVal: ---

(define-fun Diamond.diamondVal ((this Ref)) Int
  (diamondVal (deref-Diamond this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Diamond (TopLevelDeclarations!d this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (Diamond.baseVal (TopLevelDeclarations!d this)) 0)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 0) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (Diamond.leftVal (TopLevelDeclarations!d this)) 0)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 0) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (Diamond.rightVal (TopLevelDeclarations!d this)) 0)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv4 0) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (Diamond.diamondVal (TopLevelDeclarations!d this)) 0)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv5 0) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Invariant 6: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv6 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Diamond.baseVal (TopLevelDeclarations!d this)) 10)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv6 0) :named _xkassert5))



; -----------------------------
;   Invariant for class Base:
; -----------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-Base Base)



; -----------------------------
;   Invariant for class Left:
; -----------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-Left Left)



; ------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Right:
; ------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-4-Right Right)



; --------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Diamond:
; --------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-3-Diamond Diamond)




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        2 (lift-Base const-2-Base))
        1 (lift-Left const-1-Left))
        4 (lift-Right const-4-Right))
        3 (lift-Diamond const-3-Diamond))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-1-Left () Left
  (mk-Left 7 8))
(define-fun const-2-Base () Base
  (mk-Base 9))
(define-fun const-4-Right () Right
  (mk-Right 5 6))
(define-fun const-3-Diamond () Diamond
  (mk-Diamond 10 1 7720 21239))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 3))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (d (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (> (leftVal (sel-Diamond a!1)) 0)))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (d (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (= (baseVal (sel-Diamond a!1)) 10)))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (d (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-Diamond a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (d (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (> (rightVal (sel-Diamond a!1)) 0)))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (d (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (> (baseVal (sel-Diamond a!1)) 0)))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (d (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (> (diamondVal (sel-Diamond a!1)) 0)))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
                         0
                         (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 3)))
                  2
                  (lift-Base (mk-Base 9)))))
(let ((a!2 (store (store a!1 1 (lift-Left (mk-Left 7 8)))
                  4
                  (lift-Right (mk-Right 5 6)))))
  (store a!2 3 (lift-Diamond (mk-Diamond 10 1 7720 21239))))))
